Subject: ClosedLoop RFP: private deployment pricing & packaging questions

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking a look at our RFP (attached). A few clarifying asks from procurement as we prepare the vendor short list: 

- We plan a 6-month pilot across 2 US sites, then a phased roll to 6 sites in year 1. We expect token-heavy data-processing on site (HIPAA scoped).
- Can Redwood waive or significantly reduce the platform fee for the pilot period? Our legal/finance prefers capex-friendly wording — amortization of platform fee across a 24-month term would help.
- Need clear support tier options: what uptime SLA, response times, and included engineering hours for Level 2/3?
- Are there volume/seat discounts for multiple deploy sites and operator licenses? We want a simple ladder rather than bespoke redlines.

Timeline: procurement needs a commercial term sheet by July 9 to make a Q3 budget call. Please include any standard compliance addenda (SOC2, HIPAA BAAs).

Attaching the RFP and scope doc. Can we schedule 30 minutes Monday to run through numbers?

Thanks,
Liz Byrne

Hi Liz — thanks for the RFP and the clear timeline. I reviewed with Marissa (commercial lead) and Irene (solutions/legal). High level responses below; attaching a pricing workbook and a draft SOW so you have concrete numbers to work with.

Quick answers up front:
- Pilot platform fee: we can offer a pilot waiver for the initial 6 months conditioned on a 24-month committed term thereafter (platform fee amortized over term).
- Support tiers: three standard tiers (Standard, Business, Enterprise). For HIPAA-scoped private deploys we recommend Enterprise which includes 24/7 on-call with a defined L2 response time of 4 hours and a 72-hour target for critical on-call engineering patches. Draft SLA included in Terms_Summary.
- Volume discounts: we propose a stepped ladder by deployed site count + operator licenses. Workbook has examples for 2, 6, and 12-site rollouts and the corresponding per-site operator/license cost.

Proposed next steps:
1) Review attached Redwood_VPC_pricing_20260704.xlsx and Redwood_PrivDeploy_Draft_SOW_20260704.docx.
2) Quick call Mon 10am PT to walk the pricing ladder.
3) If acceptable, we issue a commercial term sheet and send a DocuSign package for the pilot amendment + BAA.

I attached the pricing workbook and draft SOW. Marissa — can you confirm if we should include a limited implementation credit for ClosedLoop as an early-adopter concession (yes/no)?

Best,

Liz / Chloe — looping in the commercial playbook suggestions so procurement has something prescriptive. TL;DR: we can do pilot waiver + structured concession, but need a clear ramp and commit.

Commercial proposal (high level):
- Pilot (0-6 months): platform fee waived, implementation credit of $25k applied to first invoice. Pilot includes Enterprise support-lite (business hours escalation to engineering + dedicated kickoff SRE days).
- Production (months 7-24): 24-month commitment covering 6 sites: platform fee amortized at 50% of list in year 1, full list thereafter; per-site operator license discounted 18% at 6 sites, 25% at 12 sites.
- SLA credits: financial credits start at 99.5% availability threshold for Enterprise SLA.

Legal/ops notes: we can include a clause to cap the platform fee exposure if ClosedLoop provides a signed PO by Aug 1 or a confirmed capacity commit in HubSpot.

Irene — please confirm the standard BAA language is attached and whether the SOC2 audit artifact timeline (we expect to share within 7 days) is fine for ClosedLoop.

If this looks acceptable to you, Chloe — I will draft the term sheet and push to DocuSign so we can meet the July 9 procurement deadline.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Chloe — thanks for the quick turnaround and the workbook. A few clarifying counterpoints from finance/procurement: 

- The pilot waiver is appreciated; procurement prefers the implementation credit flow into a capped platform-fee exposure rather than amortization backloaded into year 2. In short: cap platform fee liability to $60k total for 24 months unless we expand beyond the committed 6 sites.
- Support hours: we need a firm number of included L2 engineering hours per month for the Enterprise tier during pilot and the defined run-rate for production. Can you add that to the term sheet?
- Compliance artifacts: legal needs SOC2 Type II report and BAA redline within 3 business days to start internal legal review.

Procurement timeline remains tight — we need the commercial term sheet and a redlineable contract by end of day July 9 to meet our Q3 approval window. Rajesh (cc) will be the finance approver and will confirm budget once we have a term sheet.

If you can send the updated term sheet with the $60k cap option and the included monthly L2 hours, we should be able to proceed to signature quickly.

Liz / Rajesh — thanks for the clear ask and the deadline. We've prepared a revised commercial term sheet that captures the items you requested. Summary below and DocuSign link in the related links field. Full term sheet and contract redline-ready docs are attached to the DocuSign package.

Key commercial commitments (summary):
- Pilot concession: 100% platform fee waiver for first 6 months + $25k implementation credit.
- Platform fee exposure cap: $60,000 cap for months 1-24 if ClosedLoop signs PO by 2026-08-01 and remains on the 6-site commit. Overages beyond 6 sites revert to standard per-site fee.
- Support: Enterprise support includes 24/7 incident intake, guaranteed L2 engineering allocation of 12 hours/month during pilot, 20 hours/month in production months 7-24 (additional hours billable at our time-and-materials rate or included in a retainer).
- SLA credits: financial credits apply for uptime below 99.5%; see Section 4 of the attached Terms_Summary_20260709.pdf.
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II report and BAA redline attached to the DocuSign package; we will deliver audit artifacts within 3 business days of your written confirmation.

Next steps: sign via DocuSign, Redwood legal will turn around any reasonable redlines within 48 hours, and we will begin pilot kickoff within 10 business days of execution.

Please confirm acceptance or send redlines; Chloe will follow up to schedule a 30-minute legal/commercial sync if helpful.

Regards,
Irene Choi
